findings.text: This technical report has no safety, alignment, toxicity, bias, jailbreak, or dangerous-capability evaluation section; "Ethics and Safety" appears only as an acknowledgments role.
The authors point to the Responsible Deployment section of the Gemma paper for limitations and benefits of open models, rather than reporting CodeGemma-specific safety results.
Pretraining data was filtered to remove evaluation-code contamination and certain personal and sensitive data (a training filter, not a model-behavior safety claim).

notes: Technical report focused on code capability (HumanEval, MBPP, HumanEval Infilling, BabelCode multilingual HE/MBPP, MATH/GSM8K, and Figure 3 language benchmarks). No safety eval numbers. Pilot override: skipped general capability evalResults. Two-column PDF layout; quotes are short contiguous fragments. pageCount=11 (trailing empty form-feed page ignored).
